title: Refund a defective / not-as-described purchase
summary: Full refund or replacement for a defective or not-as-described item, with a chargeback fallback.
goal_default: Please issue a full refund or send a replacement, along with a prepaid return label.

rights.claim: Items that are faulty or not as described are commonly covered by statutory rights or buyer protection.
rights.basis: EU/UK consumer sales rights for non-conforming goods (e.g. UK Consumer Rights Act 2015).

rights.claim: A card chargeback for 'not as described' is a strong fallback if the seller refuses.
rights.basis: Card-scheme chargeback rules; marketplace buyer-protection programs.

artifact.subject: Defective / not-as-described item — refund requested

disclaimer: This is information to help you write your own request. It is not legal advice and guarantees no outcome.
